name: Style bake-off
purpose: Renders one representative beat as structurally different composition archetypes (not re-skins) with HyperFrames snapshots, measures their distinctness against a re-skin control, writes a comparison sheet and bakeoff.json, and records the director's decision plus a derived project design profile.
capabilities: run: archetype candidates, stills, metrics, control re-skin, distinctness verdict, sheet
decide: scores, rationale, decided_by, project design-profile.json
list-archetypes (9 built in; add one by writing a function)

compatibility.notes: Four candidates in about 12 s at 300 MB peak. Stills undersell motion-led directions; use --motion for short samples.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Runs hyperframes under the render lock. Candidate folders are regenerated and gitignored.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
